gloss: the following week; the next week

definitions.gloss: the following week; the next week
definitions.explanation: the following week; the next week

examples.japanese: {翌週|よくしゅう}にもう{一度|いちど}{会|あ}うことにした。
examples.english: We decided to meet once more the following week.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}は{翌週|よくしゅう}の{月曜日|げつようび}に{延期|えんき}された。
examples.english: The meeting was postponed to Monday of the following week.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}が{終|お}わり、{翌週|よくしゅう}から{春休|はるやす}みが{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: The exams ended, and spring break started from the following week.

notes:
A time expression referring to the week after a given reference point. Unlike {来週|らいしゅう} (next week), which is relative to the present moment, {翌週|よくしゅう} is used in narrative or written contexts to refer to the week after a past event. Part of the {翌|よく} series of time words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {翌週|よくしゅう}の{月曜日|げつようび}: the Monday of the following week
- {翌週|よくしゅう}に{入|はい}る: enter the following week

RELATED WORDS:
- {翌日|よくじつ}: the following day
- {翌月|よくげつ}: the following month
- {翌年|よくねん}: the following year
- {来週|らいしゅう}: next week — relative to the present, used in conversation
